# Camelify

> Camelify is a creator-first link-in-bio platform. One page for all your links — YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, your shop, booking page, and more. Custom domain on every plan, free analytics, no surprise suspensions, and fair pricing. Free to start.

Camelify gives creators and businesses a single bio link page at camelify.com/yourname (or your own custom domain). Unlike many competitors, Camelify includes custom domains, analytics, and data export on the free plan. Public pages are server-rendered for fast load times and rich social previews.

**Website:** https://www.camelify.com  
**Creator dashboard:** https://app.camelify.com  
**Contact:** hello@camelify.com  
**Twitter:** https://twitter.com/camelify  
**Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/camelify

## Product

- [Home](https://www.camelify.com/): Landing page — features, pricing promise, FAQ, and how it works
- [Sign up](https://www.camelify.com/signup): Create a free Camelify account
- [Log in](https://www.camelify.com/login): Sign in to manage your bio page
- [Creator dashboard](https://app.camelify.com): Manage links, profile, analytics, and settings

## Key features

- Custom domain on every plan, including Free
- Unlimited links on the free plan
- Free analytics: clicks, views, devices, top referrers
- One-click data export (links, analytics, email captures)
- 30+ platform integrations at launch (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X, Spotify, WhatsApp, Calendly, Shopify, Mailchimp, and more)
- Server-rendered public pages with sub-500ms first-paint target
- Human-reviewed account flags with 24-hour response window
- 60-day advance notice on any pricing changes

## FAQ

- **What is Camelify?** A link-in-bio tool — one page (camelify.com/yourname) for all your important links.
- **Is it free?** Yes. Free plan includes unlimited links, basic analytics, email capture, and all launch integrations.
- **Custom domain?** Yes, on every plan including Free.
- **Data export?** Always available on every plan, even during account review.
- **Supported platforms?** Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Spotify, Apple Music, WhatsApp, Calendly, Shopify, Stripe, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Substack, Twitch, Pinterest, and more.

## Public profiles

Creator bio pages are public at `https://www.camelify.com/{username}`. Example format: `https://www.camelify.com/yourname`
